title: Skipped the mall, but visited the reoccurring college campus center.
content: Unlike a lot of people's posts about their malls, my particular malls (there's 2, one in New York state and one in PA) are open air, more like shopping centers and I rarely enter them. Last night I didn't dream about the mall, but I did note in the dream I should stop at the NY one on the way home. Instead, I visited a college campus with a girl who I knew (that I don't actually know) that lived across the street in the dream. When I'm not dreaming of a mostly accurate version of the college I went to, I dream of the same college. The campus center, where you'd find things like the college store, library, diner, dining hall, etc is a large hexagonal space, 3 stories tall in some places. Each area is essentially a triangle originating from the central area, but the central area isn't open. Instead, there's always a circular area of offices with a hallway going around them to access the different areas of the campus center. It's strangely set up like Disney, where you can't really see any of the other sections of the campus center once you enter a specific area, but you can view several areas at once if you're traversing the space using the central hallway or taking the stairs from one story to another. In some dreams, classrooms extend from the hexagonal area via long hallways that can meander their way back to the central area in another spot. The actual dream taking place on the campus wasn't interesting though. We went to the cafeteria for lunch, but it was between mealtimes. They did have a nice looking lasagna that I was going to grab a piece of and get a salad but we had trouble finding trays and plates. I did find a stack of trays eventually, but apparently that stack of trays were dirty because it had ketchup on the bottom of it and it got all over my hands. I'm decades removed from college, but this place pops up with surprising regularity. I do have dreams about attending my college, with a fairly accurate campus, but if I'm ever visiting a college, it's this weird Mallworld one.
